content:
Hi everyone,
We are developing a Lean formalization of the Wu–Ritt characteristic set method for multivariate polynomials*.

https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/36103

The development includes main degrees, initials, polynomial order, pseudo-division, triangular sets, ascending sets, characteristic sets, and eventually zero decomposition.

We would like to ask for advice about the most appropriate location in Mathlib for this material.

Possible locations we are considering are something like:
Mathlib/Algebra/MvPolynomial/
Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPolynomial/

@Filippo A. E. Nuccio is visiting us and he suggested us to ask the question in zulip.

Reference:
*: Wen-Tsun, W. Basic principles of mechanical theorem proving in elementary geometries. Journal of Automated Reasoning 2, 221–252 (1986). https://doi.org/10.1007/BF02328447
cc @tsuki（Hao Shen) @Hagb (Junyu Guo) @Lihong Zhi
